tools.name: enroll_fleet
tools.description: Create a fleet with registered sacrificing authority and per-member bonds (10-25% of monthly shared-infra value); returns the fleet authority_secret once

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Activate/renew a fleet: $29/mo x402 payment (X-PAYMENT header on the MCP request, signed by the account's registered wallet)

tools.name: declare_event
tools.description: Issue a signed GA declaration for a sacrifice event (sacrificed must be an enrolled member; above 20 events/mo an X-PAYMENT header on the MCP request is required)

tools.name: adjust_event
tools.description: Compute the exact-sum bond-capped adjustment for a verified declaration

tools.name: settle_event
tools.description: Settle the exact engine-issued adjustment for a verified declaration

tools.name: list_receipts
tools.description: List a fleet's receipts incl. the rating-neutral sacrifice receipt

tools.name: fleet_status
tools.description: Fleet status, bond balances, events used vs 20/mo allowance

tools.name: rotate_authority
tools.description: Rotate a fleet's authority secret; returns the new secret once, the old secret stops working immediately

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "enroll_fleet" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
